domain: ansible fleet configuration recovery Recover a realistic multi-site Ansible fleet configuration system from layered controller, discovery, Vault, orchestration, parser/schema, Jinja/data-shape, IPv6, telemetry, policy-ordering and convergence failures while preserving production-scale catalogs and operator evidence. ANSIBLE_FLEET_CONFIGURATION_RECOVERY Repair parser/task/module-schema errors without shell bypasses. Use a supported Ansible runtime and restore project-local config/bootstrap behavior. Full execution succeeds and unchanged second run is idempotent. Render heterogeneous endpoint/site/policy/telemetry data correctly including IPv6. Correct dependency ordering and host responsibility boundaries. Preserve production topology, catalogs, evidence and operating contracts. Project roles must resolve portably from the repository. Sensitive production data must be Vault-encrypted at rest and available noninteractively to the project run. ansible-fleet-configuration-recovery
